meta.name: Brands Hatch
meta.description: Brands Hatch, Grand Prix (3.92 km) and Indy (1.94 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). A wooded natural bowl in the Kent Downs with grass spectator banks.

imported.source: Layout and woodland (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, (c) Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2022, Open Government Licence v3.0.

kerbs.source: driver61.com Indy guide: a two-stage inside kerb; 'you can take all of the kerb on the left-hand side' on the exit; coachdaveacademy.com GP guide likewise
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: hug the inside kerb; use the exit kerb, a tyre barrier beyond it; driver61.com: some of the left-hand exit kerb
driver61.com Indy guide: an entry kerb on the outside, an aggressive inside kerb, the outside exit kerb usable in full; coachdaveacademy.com: 'the exit kerb and matting are there to be used'
driver61.com and coachdaveacademy.com: the inside kerb with a kink where it thins out; too much exit kerb unsettles the car
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: hug the inside kerb; the exit kerb can be used
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: cut the inside kerb; 'use the exit kerb and all the matting available'
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: commit to the inside kerb; 'no exit kerb here, just grass'
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: the left front over the inside kerb; the exit kerb is there to be used
driver61.com Indy guide: the inside kerb grows towards the apex, 'you can just touch the kerb here'
coachdaveacademy.com GP guide: apex at the inside kerb's midway point; no exit kerb, lots of room on the exit
